runs.name: moe-down-filter-profile-q8192-out512-mode0-r1

spec.purpose: Diagnostic MoE subphase timing with marker filtering disabled, not uninstrumented performance. Actual default-off MoE down consumer filtering with one new MoE DLL in both arms. Before original selected down replay, certify the eight weighted contribution intervals through the original VT4 sum and completed shared merge. Only a fixed combined BF16 endpoint permits omission, preserving the complete original unrounded F32 residual. Every uncertified candidate retains original K16 replay and expert ordering. Certification waits on the same-call shared-done event; private bitmap, counters and guards are checked after original production combine. Other components and selectors remain fixed, including whole-provider mode0. Both arms require original8192 prompt IDs, all512 GB10 output IDs, first logit tolerance0.125 and actual streaming callbacks. No prefix, long-context, package or release qualification is inherited.

runs.activation_scope: All40 q8192 MoE down calls certify the original eight-route contribution interval and completed shared merge. Only a fixed combined BF16 endpoint permits omission of selected original replay, preserving the complete unrounded residual. The original collector/expert ordering/K16 remain active for every uncertified candidate.

timing_scope: Same-DLL fresh-process q8192/out512 pair with only MoE subphase profiling enabled and marker filtering disabled relative to each matching uninstrumented run. All40 MoE ordinals and all GPU timing intervals are present, finite and nonnegative. Down correction includes the filter certificate, same-call shared dependency, collection, expert permutation and retained original replay when enabled. Routed/shared and nested subphases overlap and must not be summed. Instrumentation adds wall time, so these TTFTs are diagnostic and are not retained-performance measurements.
decision: Keep consumer filtering default-off. Actual omission preserves all512 GB10 IDs and callbacks, but down correction saves only141.749895ms and wholeMoE only81.955012ms in this instrumented pair. The uninstrumented pair has no net TTFT gain. Even eliminating the original805.620793ms targeted interval cannot close the remaining q8192 gap. Continue a broader exact arithmetic/dataflow replacement instead of further narrow filter tuning. No compound variant is inferred or accepted.
